tools.name: search_models
tools.description: Search the live UnoRouter model catalog (every major provider behind one OpenAI-compatible key). Models ending in :free cost nothing. Returns matching model IDs usable with the chat tool or any OpenAI-compatible client pointed at https://api.unorouter.com/v1.

query.description: Substring filter on the model id, e.g. 'deepseek' or 'claude'

tools.name: chat
tools.description: Send a single prompt to any UnoRouter model and return the reply. Use search_models to find model IDs; :free models cost nothing (light per-model rate limit, rotate models if you hit 429).

model.description: Model id from search_models, e.g. deepseek-v4-flash:free

prompt.description: The user message to send to the model

system.description: Optional system prompt sent before the user message

max_tokens.description: Upper bound on reply length in tokens; the model default when omitted

temperature.description: Sampling temperature from 0 (deterministic) to 2 (most random); the model default when omitted

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Look up per-token pricing for UnoRouter models from the public pricing endpoint. Prices are USD list prices per 1M tokens before per-group discounts (the account dashboard shows the exact effective rate). :free models are always 0.

query.description: Substring filter on the model name
